hooks.name: Spec-First Development Reminder
hooks.description: Reminds Kiro to check the specs and steering docs before implementing a new feature, ensuring spec-driven development is followed.

action.prompt: Before implementing this task, read .kiro/specs/todoflow-requirements.md and .kiro/specs/architecture.md to confirm the implementation plan aligns with the acceptance criteria and architecture. If the task introduces a new feature not covered by an existing acceptance criterion, note that the spec should be updated first. Keep task-logic.js (pure logic) and app.js (DOM layer) concerns strictly separated per the architecture spec.
